name: agent-context-pruner
description: Replaces Claude Code's compaction summary with decision-model pruning: stale tool calls and results are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim.

provider.title: Decision model provider
provider.description: auto picks TypeSafe when TYPESAFE_API_KEY or an API key is set, then Cloudflare when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and an account id are set, else the rules-based model.

model.title: Model name
model.description: Model sent to the provider. Leave empty for its default (jev-latest, clef, nimble).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Key for the chosen provider. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from the environment.

baseUrl.title: Server URL
baseUrl.description: Root of a local or custom SystemOne server, for example http://localhost:11434. The plugin appends /v1/systemone.

accountId.title: Cloudflare account id
accountId.description: For the cloudflare provider. Leave empty to use CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum keep probability for a tool call or result to stay. Leave empty for the model's own default.

compactAtPercent.title: Auto-compact at context percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which the plugin asks for a compaction after a turn. 0 turns this off.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Share of characters that must be removed for the pruned history to replace the built-in summary.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a dropped tool result kept before its note.

fallbackToHeuristic.title: Fall back to the rules-based model
fallbackToHeuristic.description: When the chosen model is unavailable or fails, prune with the rules-based model instead of going straight to the built-in summary.

noteDroppedCalls.title: Note dropped calls
noteDroppedCalls.description: Leave a one-line note where a dropped tool call's result was, so the model knows what was removed and can re-run it.

preCompactHooks.title: PreCompact hooks
preCompactHooks.description: run: before the pruned history replaces the transcript, let Claude Code run its classic PreCompact hooks (ECC's pre-compact, your own); costs one small summary request. skip: faster, but those hooks do not run.
